subject: Money
title: What Is a Blockchain
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is a Blockchain.

hook.text: Imagine a notebook where every page is locked once written. Everyone has a copy. Nobody can erase anything.

buildup.text: A blockchain is a digital ledger shared across thousands of computers. Each block has transactions linking to the last.

discovery.text: Once a block is added, altering it would require changing every subsequent block on every copy. Practically impossible.

twist.text: Blockchains are slow. Bitcoin handles 7 transactions per second. Visa handles 65,000. Speed is the cost of security.

climax.text: Blockchain's real innovation is trustless consensus: strangers agree on truth without needing to trust each other.

punchline.text: A shared truth that nobody controls.

quiz.question: How many transactions per second can Bitcoin process?
